offer_angle: One responsibility relevant to the new role
required_evidence: Verified current role, employer, date, offer fit
exclusions: Unverified appointment, old address, active owner conversation
cta: Is this area part of your remit?

relationship: Warm account; contact may be cold
offer_angle: A relevant offer matched to account context
required_evidence: Qualifying company criteria and independent contact fit
exclusions: Negative/exiting intent, unrelated visits, tracking disclosure
cta: Is this a priority for your team?

trigger: Positive Research level change or Company Surge
offer_angle: One issue tied to the actual research topic
required_evidence: Topic relevance, account fit, current contact responsibility
exclusions: Assumed individual research or buying intent
cta: Is this topic relevant to your work?

trigger: Closed Lost deal, or meeting outcome No show; the segment defines which (optionally plus a changed obstacle or agreed follow-up date)
offer_angle: Reopen the earlier topic; if something changed since, lead with that
required_evidence: Relevant deal or meeting, owner agreement; loss reason or meeting topic where recorded
exclusions: Explicit refusal or opt-out, active deal, rescheduled meeting, owner already in conversation
cta: Is the topic we discussed worth revisiting?

trigger: Known service interest plus relevant signal or CRM change
required_evidence: Contact-level history, exact offer, fresh relevance
exclusions: Only anonymous activity, conflicting active owner conversation
cta: Would this approach help with the issue we discussed?

offer_angle: One capacity, enablement, or process consideration
required_evidence: Live relevant postings and offer connection
exclusions: Stale jobs, presumed understaffing or replacement of hires
cta: Is this part of your hiring plan?

trigger: Funding, Geographic expansion, or Physical expansion
offer_angle: One execution consideration connected to the stated initiative
exclusions: Invented budget, project stage, deadlines, or operational problem
cta: Is this an area you are planning for?

trigger: Merger and acquisition or relevant asset/spinoff event
required_evidence: Transaction status, correct entities, contact remit
exclusions: Assumed completed transaction, systems consolidation, or buying authority
cta: Is this work part of the integration scope?

trigger: Named-contact CRM activity; not News Event attendance alone
offer_angle: Extend the specific topic with useful context
exclusions: Registration called attendance, anonymous visit, owner handling request
cta: Would a practical perspective on this topic be useful?

trigger: Job started plus real prior relationship
offer_angle: Reconnect and check relevance in the new role
required_evidence: New employer/role, relationship, account fit, owner agreement
exclusions: Old employer assumptions, confidential details, wrong address
cta: Is this relevant in your new role?

trigger: Account tier (for example Tier 3 or 4 in the client's tier property), optionally combined with an intent signal
offer_angle: Tier sets the approach: a lighter warm-up (useful insight, soft CTA) or a direct pitch; the client chooses per tier
required_evidence: Populated tier property, segment by tier, contact fit
exclusions: Accounts in active rep outreach, open deals, customers
cta: Warm-up: Is this on your radar? Direct: Worth a short conversation?
